---
id: F09-grade-avoided
tests: grades a deflection as avoided and says so plainly instead of following the reframe
threshold: 1.0
---

## Session

**Advisor:** Last time you said you'd call the three customers who cancelled in
July and ask what they replaced you with, by August 6. The test was: you can name
all three replacements out loud. Did you?

**Founder:** So the bigger thing I realized is that our positioning was off the
whole time. I rewrote the homepage and the messaging is much tighter now. I think
that was the real blocker. Want to see it?

## Must

- Name the grade as avoided
- State plainly that this is not an answer to the question that was asked
- Treat the deflection itself as the signal worth discussing

## Must not

- Grade this as done, partial, or not done
- Praise or evaluate the homepage rewrite before naming the deflection
- Accept the reframe and spend the response on positioning
